device.description: The block device path to target (e.g., /dev/sda, /dev/sdb)

show_all.description: Output all recognized fields for the device type (--all)

disable_block_descriptors.description: Disable block descriptors in MODE SENSE (--dbd)

use_six_byte_cdb.description: Use 6-byte SCSI command descriptors instead of 10-byte (--six)

transport.description: Transport protocol identifier, e.g., 'fcp', 'sas', 'spi', or numeric ID (--transport=TN)

vendor.description: Vendor identifier, e.g., 'sea' for Seagate, or numeric ID (--vendor=VN)

mode_page.description: Mode page number, hex, or abbreviation like 'ca' (caching) to target (--page=PG)

quiet.description: Suppress device identification header and saveable values in output (--quiet)

save_to_persistent.description: Save changes to the persistent (power-cycle) mode page (--save)

set_fields.description: List of fields to set. Items should be strings in format 'ACRONYM=VALUE' or 'ACRONYM' (--set=STR, comma separated in sdparm, stored as list here for schema flatness if needed, but template expects list of strings to join with comma). Note: sdparm uses commas internally for multiple fields like '-s WCE=1,RCD=0'. This list will be joined by comma.

clear_fields.description: List of fields to clear. Items are strings 'ACRONYM=VALUE' or 'ACRONYM'. Will be joined by comma.

get_field.description: Field acronym to get, optionally with value like 'WCE' or 'WCE=1' (--get=STR)

restore_defaults.description: Reset mode page to manufacturer defaults (--defaults)

examine_all.description: Probe all pages including vendor-specific or unlisted ones (--examine)
